game.name: Luigi's Mansion
game.rules:
#General Game Notes

- You may play on a file which has saved after beating the game to skip the intro cutscenes.
- Timing starts on file select.
- Timing ends on suck-up of King Boo.
   - If receiving credits via a Credits Warp, timing ends on suck-up of the Boss Ghost that triggered the credits sequence.
- Use of any sort of turbo controller or other likewise feature to help play the game is banned.
- All runs must be done RTA.

#Mansion Rules

- Unless stated otherwise, runs of any category may be completed in the Normal Mansion of any version, or the Hidden Mansion of NTSC-U or NTSC-J.
- Normal Mansion [NM] categories must be completed entirely in the Normal Mansion of any version.
- PAL [PAL] categories must be completed entirely in the Hidden Mansion of the PAL version. You may use the homebrew application Nintendont to load a PAL disc. Note that this only applies to PAL categories, and **not** for using the PAL version for other categories (for example, running Any% (No OoB) [NM] on PAL Normal Mansion).

#Emulator and Video Proof Rules

- **More details about these rules for specific categories can be found under the Category Rules.**
- For some categories, video proof is required and emulators are banned for all run submissions.
- For other categories, video proof is required and emulators are banned only for times below a certain threshold, depending on the category.
- You may load your disc using homebrew applications as long as they do not affect the load times of the game. If you are unsure about what applications are allowed, ask a moderator. The only exception to this is for PAL categories, as mentioned above.

categories.name: Any% (No OoB)
categories.rules:
#Any% (No OoB) Rules:

- Beat the game. The Out of Bounds glitch is banned.
- For times below 1:05:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
#Any% rules:

- Beat the game, no other restrictions.
- Due to the difficulty and nature of this category, all submissions must be completed on official disc, and video proof is required.

#100% Rules:

- Beat the game after collecting all Portrait Ghosts, all 50 boos and an A Rank.
- Requires 100,000,000G in money for A Rank.
- For times under 1:20:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

categories.name: All Boos
categories.rules:
#All Boos Rules:

- Beat the game after collecting all 50 boos.
- For times under 1:15:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

categories.name: All Portraits
categories.rules:
#All Portraits Rules:

- Beat the game after collecting all Portrait Ghosts.
- For times under 1:12:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

categories.name: Any% (No OoB) [NM]
categories.rules:
#Any% (No OoB) [NM] Rules:

- Beat the game. The Out of Bounds glitch is banned.
- Runs must be completed entirely in the Normal Mansion.
- For times below 1:10:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

categories.name: 100% [NM]
categories.rules:
#100% [NM] Rules:

- Beat the game after collecting all Portrait Ghosts, all 50 boos and an A Rank.
- Requires 100,000,000G in money for A Rank*.
- Runs must be completed entirely in the Normal Mansion
- For times under 1:25:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

*Due to a glitch in the PAL version of the game, it is not possible to achieve the A Rank in the Normal Mansion, as it requires 150,000,000G. We will still accept runs done on the PAL version that have at least 100,000,000G.

categories.name: Any% (No OoB) [PAL]
categories.rules:
#Any% (No OoB) [PAL] Rules:

- Beat the game. The Out of Bounds glitch is banned.
- Runs must be completed entirely in the PAL Hidden Mansion.
- For times below 1:15:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

categories.name: Low%
categories.rules:
#Low% Rules:

- Beat the game with a total money count of exactly 5,000G (King Boo's Crown only). The Out of Bounds glitch is banned.
- Due to the difficulty and nature of this category, all submissions must be completed on official disc, and video proof is required.

categories.name: Max%
categories.rules:
#Max% Rules:

- Beat the game after completing all of the following objectives:
    - Collect all money
    - Rescue all Toads
    - Light up all rooms
    - Collect all 50 boos, all Portrait Ghosts and all gold frames
- Requires 142,390,000G in money.
- All money must be collected from its original location.
- Due to the difficulty and nature of this category, all submissions must be completed on official disc, and video proof is required.

categories.name: 100% [PAL]
categories.rules:
#100% [PAL] Rules:

- Beat the game after collecting all Portrait Ghosts, all 50 boos and an A Rank.
- Requires 150,000,000G in money for A Rank.
- Runs must be completed entirely in the PAL Hidden Mansion.
- For times under 1:40:00, emulators are banned and video proof is required.

WOW!! What a run! Super super happy with this. Moonshot and King Boo golds too. Played extremely well. Only up from here! Thanks for the support from everyone. Only 27 seconds to 54 ;)
